## Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

Your role as a bridge maintenance professional involves identifying and meticulously documenting structural defects to ensure safety and inform repair strategies. Here’s a comprehensive guide to help you create accurate and effective bridge maintenance reports:

**I. Preparation & Initial Information (Steps 1 & 2)**

1. **Start with the maintenance records:**  Before you begin your inspection, review previous maintenance reports, inspection records, load rating analyses, and any past repair documentation related to the bridge. This provides a baseline understanding of existing issues
